meta.name: app-vision-north-star
meta.description: Expert Product Manager + Lead Systems Architect skill for creating, evaluating, and updating the 4 strategic artifacts (App Vision, Core Workflow + Product Shape, User Journey, Core Architecture & Data Architecture). Operates as 3 strictly separate actions (Create, Evaluate, Update) and pressure-tests every line for directness, specificity, and non-contradiction.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把零散想法打磨成完整的产品与架构蓝图
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想让团队围绕新产品愿景、流程与核心架构快速对齐方向
copy.tagline_en: Turn rough ideas into a coherent product vision and architecture blueprint
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to align your team around a new product's vision, workflows, and core architecture

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 先问你要进行新建、评估还是更新,然后分别执行:新建时通过提问收集信息并写出四份战略文档;评估时只读审查并给出一份差异报告;更新时把批准的改动写回文档。
howto.when: 当你要创建、评估或更新产品战略文档(如产品愿景、核心流程、用户旅程等)时触发。

say.text: 帮我新建产品的四份战略文档
say.note: 进入新建流程,开始逐一提问。

say.text: 评估一下现有的产品愿景和用户旅程
say.note: 只读审查,产出差异报告。

say.text: 根据评估结果更新文档
say.note: 需先有已批准的评估报告。

howto.what_en: Claude becomes a PM/architect. It first asks which action you're in—Create, Evaluate, or Update—then: for Create, asks questions and writes 4 docs; for Evaluate, reviews and produces a delta report; for Update, applies approved edits.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to create, evaluate, or update strategic product docs (e.g., vision, core workflow, user journey).

say_en.text: Create the four strategic docs for our product.
say_en.note: Starts the Create flow with questions.

say_en.text: Evaluate our current product vision and user journey.
say_en.note: Read-only review; outputs a delta report.

say_en.text: Update the docs based on the evaluation report.
say_en.note: Requires an approved eval report first.
